'''Robert Bowles''' (also published as '''Rob Bowles''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] on 5 October 2000 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him with scouts]], according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1356">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ rexbanner-goes-to-d-con], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
